mechanism: Ritonavir inhibits CYP2C9 and glucuronidation pathways, increasing sodium valproate concentrations and toxicity risk; valproate may inhibit ritonavir metabolism and increase its levels.
action: Monitor valproate serum levels closely; consider alternative anticonvulsant or adjust valproate dose; monitor for valproate toxicity signs (tremor, ataxia, sedation) and ritonavir efficacy.
